categories.main_business_segments: Sanhe Tongfei Refrigeration Co., Ltd. specializes in industrial temperature control equipment, offering four main product series: liquid constant temperature equipment, electrical box constant temperature devices, pure water cooling units, and special heat exchangers. These products serve diverse industries including CNC machine tools, laser equipment, semiconductor manufacturing, power electronics, energy storage, hydrogen energy, data centers, new energy vehicles (charging and swapping), and industrial washing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced thermal engineering, control systems, and energy-efficient technologies, including high-precision temperature control (up to ±0.1°C), multi-medium temperature control, and closed-loop liquid circulation systems. Production is order-driven, combining standardized and customized manufacturing, with partial outsourcing for components like sheet metal and wiring harnesses to optimize scale and capacity. R&D integrates technical and product development, collaborating with universities and customers for innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading manufacturers in CNC machine tools, laser equipment, semiconductor fabrication, power electronics, energy storage systems, hydrogen energy equipment, data centers, new energy vehicle charging/swapping stations, and industrial washing machinery. The company maintains strong partnerships with prominent domestic and international firms such as Haitan Precision, Nidec, Raycus Laser, Ningde Times, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, accounting for over 95% of revenue, with growing international presence through its wholly-owned German subsidiary ATF Cooling GmbH. The international operations facilitate technology exchange and access to European markets, supporting global expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sanhe Tongfei operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of industrial temperature control equipment that serve as critical components for downstream industrial equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening capabilities in energy storage, high-end equipment manufacturing, power electronics, semiconductor manufacturing, hydrogen energy, data centers, and new energy vehicles. The company emphasizes product innovation, precision temperature control, energy efficiency, and environmental adaptability. R&D efforts focus on developing multi-channel high-precision cooling systems, environmentally friendly refrigerants, and intelligent control systems, supported by collaborations with academic and research institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of industrial temperature control products and customized solutions. The company employs a direct sales model with a division-based management structure to closely align with customer needs and provide technical consulting, installation, and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sanhe Tongfei is a leading domestic player in the industrial temperature control sector with a strong market position in CNC machine tools and laser equipment temperature control. It competes with both domestic and international firms, leveraging its broad product portfolio, technological innovation, and customer service to maintain competitive advantages and expand market share, especially in emerging sectors like semiconductor and energy storage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.845 billion, an 83.13% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 182.38 million, up 42.69%. The company has shown strong growth driven by expanding orders, especially in power electronics and energy storage segments. Total assets reached RMB 2.175 billion, reflecting a 17% increase, supported by ongoing capacity expansion and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sanhe Tongfei emphasizes high-precision, energy-efficient, and reliable temperature control solutions tailored to diverse industrial applications. Its products feature advanced thermal management, strong environmental adaptability, and integration with intelligent control systems. The company’s comprehensive service system, strong R&D capabilities, and strategic partnerships enable it to deliver customized, high-quality solutions that enhance equipment safety, precision, and lifespan, positioning it as a benchmark in the domestic industrial temperature control market.
